definitions.explanation: An orbit shaped like an ellipse, in which the orbiting body's distance from the central object varies over the course of one revolution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The moon traces an elliptical orbit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: The Earth moves around the sun in an elliptical orbit.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧な⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Most planets have elliptical orbits rather than perfect circles.

notes:
USAGE: {楕円軌道|だえんきどう} is an elliptical (oval) orbit, in which the orbiting body's speed and distance vary. It combines ⟦{楕円|だえん}→楕円：04052_daen⟧ (ellipse) with ⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧ (orbit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楕円軌道|だえんきどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to trace an elliptical orbit
- {楕円軌道|だえんきどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to move in an elliptical orbit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{円軌道|えんきどう}→円軌道：29617_enkidou⟧: circular orbit — constant distance from the center
- ⟦{静止軌道|せいしきどう}→静止軌道：29619_seishikidou⟧: geostationary orbit
